annotations.title: Read a site's robots.txt rules per crawler

description: Returns whether each named answer engine, search crawler and training crawler may fetch one path under a domain's robots file, read the way crawlers read it. It also flags crawlers whose own group cancels the rules under *. Use for a robots.txt question alone. For the full path a crawler takes use crawler_path; for a corrected file use fix_robots.
name: resolve_robots
title: Read a site's robots.txt rules per crawler
